description: This file defines the AuthViewModel class responsible for managing authentication state and logic in a SwiftUI application, including login and signup functionalities, as well as the associated AuthStore class for persistence.

classes.name: AuthViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing user authentication, including login, sign-up, and state handling in a SwiftUI app.

classes.name: AuthStore
classes.description: Class handling persistent storage and retrieval of user data and current user session using UserDefaults.

methods.name: AuthViewModel.init
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel, binding it to an AuthStore and loading the current user.

methods.name: AuthViewModel.logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by clearing stored user data.

methods.name: AuthViewModel.login
methods.description: Handles user login by validating credentials and updating the user state.

methods.name: AuthViewModel.signUp
methods.description: Handles user registration, including validation and storage of new user data.

methods.name: AuthViewModel.isValidEmail
methods.description: Utility method for basic email validation.

methods.name: AuthViewModel.hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes password input, using CryptoKit if available, otherwise a reversible stub.

methods.name: AuthStore.loadCurrentUser
methods.description: Loads the currently logged-in user from persistent storage.

methods.name: AuthStore.setCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets the current user in persistent storage.

methods.name: AuthStore.clearCurrentUser
methods.description: Clears the stored current user info.

methods.name: AuthStore.findUser
methods.description: Finds and returns a user by email from stored users.

methods.name: AuthStore.addUser
methods.description: Adds a new user to persistent storage.

methods.name: AuthStore.loadUsers
methods.description: Loads the list of users from storage, decoding JSON data.

methods.name: AuthStore.saveUsers
methods.description: Saves a list of users to persistent storage, encoding as JSON.
